import glob
import os
import re
import tempfile

from nutrient_sdk import (DescriptionLevel, Document,
                          ImageExportFormat, Vision)
from nutrient_sdk.vlmprovider import VlmProvider

# Vision.describe() reads ONE page image, so this path handles PAGE 1
# ONLY — it is not a whole-document summary. export_as_image()
# rasterises EVERY page in one call; this snippet uses only the first
# one. The pages go to a private temporary directory, so nothing is
# left in your working directory and a second run cannot pick up the
# first run's output.
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as pages_dir:
    base = os.path.join(pages_dir, "page.jpg")
    with Document.open("lumen-invoice.pdf") as document:
        images = document.get_settings().get_image_settings()
        images.set_export_format(ImageExportFormat.JPEG)
        document.export_as_image(base)

    # Multi-page writes page-1.jpg, page-2.jpg, …; a single-page
    # document is written to page.jpg itself, which is why the glob
    # needs the `base` fallback. Sort numerically so 10 follows 9.
    paths = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(pages_dir, "page-*.jpg")),
                   key=lambda p: int(re.search(r"-(\d+)\.jpg$", p).group(1)))
    paths = paths or [base]

    # Still inside the with: the JPEG is deleted when it exits. Only
    # the first page is opened — this endpoint is page 1 only.
    with Document.open(paths[0]) as page:
        settings = page.get_settings()
        descriptor = settings.get_vision_descriptor_settings()
        descriptor.set_level(DescriptionLevel.DETAILED)
        descriptor.set_standard_prompt("Describe this page for someone who cannot see it.")
        settings.get_vision_settings().set_provider(VlmProvider.CLAUDE)
        settings.get_claude_api_settings().set_api_key(os.environ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"])

        print(Vision.set(page).describe())
